newsitem.title: USA: Transco plans to expand Ga. gas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Transco plans to expand Ga. gas pipeline.

text.p: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Corp said Wednesday it is seeking approval to increase firm capacity on its natural gas pipeline by 87,070 dekatherms per day.
The proposed $68 million Cherokee Expansion Project would likely be complete by November 1, 1998.
The project involves the addition of about 11 miles of 48-inch pipeline looping along the mainline and about four miles of 16-inch pipeline replacement along the North Georgia Extension.
Transco also plans to build a new compressor station in Coweta County, Ga., and a new compressor unit at Station 125 in Walton County, Ga.
The facilities will then be required to increase capacity on the mainline from Station 85 in Butler, Ala., to delivery points upstream or near Station 130 in Madison County, Ga.
Transco, a unit of The Williams Cos, owns and operates a 10,000-mile pipeline system that extends from the Gulf of Mexico to New York City.
